notes.note: Sharing on macOS now uses the native macOS share picker, which shows a preview of the page and recent contacts alongside AirDrop, Messages, and other apps. Several selected tabs can also be shared at once.
Saved passwords are now available from the sidebar by default, without having to add the Passwords tool first.

Open tabs can now be searched with a keyboard shortcut: `Ctrl+Shift+A` on Windows and Linux, `Cmd+Shift+A` on macOS. The Extensions and Themes shortcut is now `Ctrl+Shift+F` on Windows and Linux, and `Cmd+Shift+E` on macOS. These shortcuts can be changed in `about:keyboard`.
Web addresses written in the Javanese, Balinese, Canadian Aboriginal Syllabics, and N'Ko scripts are now displayed in their own script instead of as encoded "xn--" text.
The AI chatbot's Summarize page option now shares the page's address with the chatbot provider instead of the page's text content.

Firefox now supports [scoped custom element registries](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/CustomElementRegistry/CustomElementRegistry). A registry created with the `CustomElementRegistry()` constructor is separate from the global `window.customElements` registry, so custom elements that share a tag name can coexist on the same page.

Firefox now supports scroll-driven animations, so CSS animations and Web Animations API animations can progress with the scroll position of a container or with an element's visibility as it scrolls into view, using the `animation-timeline`, `scroll-timeline`, `view-timeline`, and `animation-range` properties and the `ScrollTimeline` and `ViewTimeline` interfaces.

The [Sanitizer API](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/HTML_Sanitizer_API) now sanitizes HTML as it is parsed rather than afterwards, so custom element constructors no longer run for elements the sanitizer removes.
WebGL now supports the `EXT_clip_control` and `EXT_texture_mirror_clamp_to_edge` extensions and WebGL 2 supports the `EXT_texture_norm16` extension on compatible devices.
The Web Console now allows `let`, `const`, and `class` variables to be declared again, so a snippet can be edited and re-run without a redeclaration error.
Fixed quick gamepad button presses sometimes being missed in web games on macOS.
Fixed tabs sometimes detaching into a new window when clicked on Linux with Wayland.
Fixed long drop-down lists on web pages sometimes showing blank space in place of the last options until the list was scrolled.
Fixed menus and panels fading in on Windows and Linux when animation effects are turned off in the operating system.
Fixed some videos displaying incorrectly on Windows when NVIDIA RTX Video HDR is enabled.
Fixed bookmarks not being imported from Google Chrome profiles that are signed in to a Google account.
Fixed some sites, such as Slack, failing to load instead of falling back to HTTP/2 when the site rejected an HTTP/3 request.
Fixed the Replace button in Apple Writing Tools on macOS inserting the clipboard contents instead of the rewritten text on some sites, such as Gmail.
Fixed the file upload dialog opening in the last folder a file was saved to, such as Downloads, instead of the folder last used for uploads.

system_requirements:
## Windows

### Operating Systems (32-bit and 64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  1GB of RAM / 2GB of RAM for the 64-bit version
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*

- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio

Firefox Beta gets updated 3 times a week and as a consequence, the release notes for the Beta channel are updated continuously to reflect features that have reached sufficient maturity to benefit from community feedback and bug reports.
Warning: Features listed here may or may not make a final release of Firefox

In addition to these release notes, you can follow ongoing development via the [Firefox Trains][1] website or our [@FirefoxBeta][2] Bluesky account. [1]: https://whattrainisitnow.com/beta/ [2]: https://bsky.app/profile/firefoxbeta.bsky.social
